parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5244273. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter compound_records by doc_id matching the specified document, and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id in ascending order.
